workbenchBody: Something went wrong while rendering this editor. Your other work and the rest of the app are unaffected.
rootBody: An unexpected error stopped this page from rendering. The rest of the app is still available.
chunkBody: Part of the page could not be loaded from the program, usually because it was restarted or updated while this window was open. Reload the page to try again.
globalBody: A critical error stopped the app from rendering. Reloading usually fixes this.
draftHint: Try again first — it keeps any unsaved edits in this session. Reloading the page discards unsaved drafts.
